story.setup: Leadership means making people doubt what they have done until now.
story.stakes: If everyone stopped being an employee, what then? The majority will stay employees and overweight.
story.progression: A small percent will come; people ask what if no one is an employee; no; the majority will stay overweight, broke, stressed; it will continue; the minority leads; 'I am not part of this stupid game'; 'solo career'; then he mocks the employees ('go to your degrees, go to your jobs', 26-29 s) and gives an analogy of a friend inviting you on a trip and you hesitating (29-35 s, machine transcript).
story.payoff: 'I do not participate in the stupid game' (22-24 s), then an unfinished analogy of a friend inviting you on a trip, 'maybe I will join, let me check what I want to do' (29-35 s).
